name: Autotest
description: Soft/hardware integration test rail: requirement decomposition, case generation, a human review gate, script authoring, execution, failure analysis and reporting.
author: PI Desktop

agentTools.name: autotest_requirement
agentTools.description: Decompose a requirement source into features, acceptance criteria and open gaps, and open a test plan for it.

planId.description: existing plan id; omit to create a new plan

source.description: requirement text, PRD excerpt or acceptance criteria

gapsConfirmed.description: set once a human answered the open gaps

agentTools.name: autotest_cases
agentTools.description: Generate the case set for the requirement stage and hand it to the human review gate.

action.description: generate or regenerate the case set

agentTools.name: autotest_select
agentTools.description: Select or deselect cases before approval, or list them with their current selection.

action.description: apply the id list as selected or deselected

agentTools.name: autotest_author
agentTools.description: Author one runnable script per approved case. Refuses while the review gate is closed.

action.description: write scripts for the approved case set

testCaseIds.description: optional subset of case ids to author in this call; batch at most 3 per call because each script needs its own model call

language.description: preferred script language, for example javascript or python

agentTools.name: autotest_run
agentTools.description: Execute the authored scripts and record every result. Refuses while the review gate is closed.

agentTools.name: autotest_diagnose
agentTools.description: Classify every failure of the last run and say whether a script repair is legitimate. Never rewrites a script.

agentTools.name: autotest_report
agentTools.description: Write the run report for the plan as markdown next to its state.

agentTools.name: autotest_status
agentTools.description: Show the rail state of one plan, or list every plan when no id is given.

planId.description: target plan id; omit to list plans

safetyNotes: Writes only inside its own plugin data directory. Executes scripts without a shell, passing an argument array, with a per-script timeout and a bounded output buffer. Scripts are written only after a recorded human approval, and failure analysis never rewrites a script or weakens an assertion. Runs no background service and opens no network listener.

zh-CN.name: 自动化测试
zh-CN.description: 软硬件集成测试链路：需求分解、用例生成、人工审核门、脚本生成、执行、失败分析与报告。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只写入本插件自己的数据目录。执行脚本不经过 shell，使用参数数组，带单脚本超时与输出上限。只有记录在案的人工批准之后才写脚本，失败分析绝不改写脚本、绝不降低断言强度。不常驻后台服务，不监听网络端口。
